name: stayzy-monorepo
description: Stayzy — Premium PG & Flexible Co-Living Platform (Frontend, Backend, Mobile)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && npm run install:mobile
scripts.setup:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npx --prefix frontend prisma generate --schema=./frontend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx --prefix frontend prisma db push --schema=./frontend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix frontend run seed
scripts.setup:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npx --prefix backend prisma generate --schema=./backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx --prefix backend prisma db push --schema=./backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c cyan.bold,green.bold "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.seed:all: npm run seed:frontend && npm run seed:backend
